company.agent_alone_hint: Minimum autonomy level for an agent to act without approval
company.auth_empty_hint: Tip from Bé Càng: press "Use default matrix" for a sensible rule set (amounts in USD), then adjust it. Until then the old approval behaviour stays.
company.auth_explain: One place for who approves what — by action type, amount (USD) and risk. Approvals, budgets, autonomy and exec requests all read this table; Inbox cards name the rule that fired. The matrix only tightens an agent's tool permissions, never loosens them.
company.charter_desc: Compiled into every agent's AGENTS.md — edits resync right away
company.charter_empty_hint: Write the mission, values, brand voice and prohibitions — every agent reads it before any task.
company.delete_confirm: Delete this rule? Matching actions fall back to the old behaviour or another rule.
company.legal_name_hint: e.g. Bat Trang Ceramics Co., Ltd
company.need_admin: View only. Admin role or higher is needed to edit the company profile.
company.pos_compile_note: JD, responsibilities and KPIs go into the AGENTS.md of agents in this seat
company.pos_empty_hint: Tip from Bé Càng: a position is a seat that exists even when empty. Create them from existing people, or add one with a JD, KPIs and headcount.
company.prohibitions_hint: Things agents never do, even when asked
company.replace_confirm: Replace all current rules with the default matrix?
company.rule_hint: Band is [from, to): leave "to" empty for no upper limit
company.save_note: After saving, agents get the new charter on their next run.
company.saved_resync: Saved · charter v{p0} is being pushed into every agent's AGENTS.md
company.sim_alone: May act alone, no approval needed.
company.sim_desc: Pick a person/agent and an action to see who must approve (no real request)
company.sim_none: No matching rule — the old approval behaviour applies.
company.skills_hint: One skill per line (currently written into AGENTS.md only)
company.title: Position title
company.tools_hint: None selected = no limit. Once chosen, tools outside the list are switched off for this seat.
company.voice_hint: Address style, formality, words to use/avoid

ops.action_hint: This step is checked against the authority matrix with the run's amount
ops.amount_hint: Used for the authority matrix (e.g. refunds from $50 need the department head)
ops.form_note: Each step belongs to a position; when run, each step becomes a task for whoever holds that position.
ops.instructions: Instructions for whoever does this step
ops.name: Process name
ops.proc_empty_hint: Tip from Bé Càng: pick a template set for your kind of company and press "Seed" — steps attach to your existing positions. Or create your own.
ops.proc_explain: Process map by the 13 APQC categories. Press Run: each step becomes a task on the board for whoever holds the step's position, the next step opens when the previous one is done, and steps with an action type go through the authority matrix. Cycle time is measured per step and per run.
ops.run_desc: Creates {p0} chained tasks assigned by position.
ops.kpi_explain: Cascaded KPIs: company goals → departments → positions → each seat. Actuals come from existing data (tasks done, process cycle time, cost per task, first-pass review rate, approvals) or manual entry. Higher levels show progress rolled up from below; an agent seat's KPIs feed its Career scorecard.
ops.kpi_empty_hint: Tip from Bé Càng: press "Pull KPIs from positions" to turn the KPIs on the Positions tab into position and per-seat KPIs, then add company KPIs linked to goals.
ops.kpi_form_note: With "Manual" you enter a number each period; other sources are computed for the current period (Vietnam time).
ops.record_desc: Period {p0}. A manual value overrides the computed one for this period.
ops.rh_explain: Morning stand-up (last 24 h) and weekly report (last 7 days) for each department and the whole company, built from tasks, processes, KPIs, approvals, costs and exceptions, delivered to the owner's Inbox. When the department head is an agent it rewrites the report from exactly those numbers; if it fails, the automatic summary is used.
ops.rh_agent: Let agent department heads write it (via the gateway)
ops.rh_now_desc: Build this period's report for the company and departments (not resent if already sent).
ops.rh_busy: Gathering numbers and waiting for the agent to write…
ops.rh_empty_hint: Tip from Bé Càng: turn on the schedule or press "Send today's stand-up" to try it.
ops.cmp_disclaimer: A reference calendar computed from the legal basis listed on each item — not legal advice. Check with your accountant or the tax office before filing; public holidays are not accounted for.
ops.cmp_need_admin: Admin role required to change filing settings.
ops.cmp_empty_hint: Tip from Bé Càng: pick your filing periods and press "Refresh calendar & send reminders".
ops.cmp_review_hint: This rule is uncertain or lacks a legal basis — check with your accountant.
ops.cmp_basis_hint: Leave empty and the item is flagged "Needs review".
ops.cmp_no_rules_hint: Tip from Bé Càng: press "Create default calendar" for VAT/PIT, annual finalization and social insurance — each item cites its legal basis and you can edit it.
ops.rd_explain: How ready the company is to hand work to agents: automatic checks on each layer (charter, positions, authority, processes, KPIs, knowledge, rhythm, compliance) plus a short questionnaire. Every unmet item links to where to fix it, and a pilot (lighthouse) process is recommended. Runs automatically when a company is created.
ops.rd_empty_hint: Tip from Bé Càng: answer a few questions below and press "Assess".
ops.rd_lighthouse_desc: Frequent, clear rules, staffed, low money risk, measurable.
ops.rd_no_lighthouse: None yet — needs at least one process with steps.
ops.rd_q_volume: Roughly how many repeat orders / requests per week?
ops.rd_q_documented: Are your main processes written down?
ops.rd_q_digital: Where does your data (orders, customers, documents) live?
ops.rd_q_reviewers: Is someone available to review exceptions every day?
ops.rd_q_risk: How much error can you tolerate while piloting agents?
ops.rd_ns_1: Keep agents on probation with heavy human review for the first 2 weeks
ops.rd_ns_2: Run this process daily and watch its cycle time on the Processes tab
ops.rd_ns_3: Set cycle-time and on-time KPIs for it on the KPI tab
ops.rd_c_legal_profile: Legal profile complete (name, entity type, tax code, representative)
ops.rd_c_charter: Charter has mission, brand voice, prohibitions
ops.rd_c_matrix: Authority matrix covers spend, refund, external messages
ops.rd_c_step_owners: Process steps bound to staffed positions
ops.rd_c_runs: At least one process run completed
ops.rd_c_compliance: Compliance calendar set up with filing settings
